chart.plot_area: 7.0in x 3.8in, wrapped in 5px border + 8px hard shadow block
chart.type_match: comparison=column, trend=4px polyline, share=donut(<=3, thick, 5px border per slice)
chart.value_label: black #0A0A0A square badge + white 14pt 900 tabular digit, on bar top
chart.axis: x baseline 4px solid #0A0A0A, y-axis & gridlines removed
chart.line: 4px #0A0A0A polyline, straight segments, square markers w/ black border
chart.render: SVG precise, square corners (radius 0), straight segments only, no diffuse shadow/gloss/bevel/3D

diagram.language: square nodes + 5px black border + flat primary fill + 8px hard shadow; 6px black connectors with 16px angular arrowhead; square black number badges; primary-color clash, max 3 per diagram

timeline.marker: 0.3in square 5px border + flat primary + 8px hard shadow, current = #FF5A36 0.42in

comparison.columns: 2-3 blocks, 5px border + 8px hard shadow + distinct primary fills

matrix.point: 0.3in square 5px border + 8px hard shadow, key = different primary

funnel.levels: 3-4 vertical, width -1.2in per step (funnel) or equal stack (hierarchy)

kpi_card.border: 5px solid #0A0A0A + flat primary fill + 8px hard shadow
